Game is a great introduction into jumping territory. Instead of dumping all the mechanics on the player at once, the game introduces them gradually, one by one. Main story route introduces collectibles which do not matter and only purpose (outside of achievements little bit) is to make the player dip into higher difficulty jumps. 

Once you finish the game (main storyline eta 6 hours), you are either satisfied or you want more jumping levels and this game provides that. 

Pros:
+ For the main storyline, levels are made short to be less frustrating, which worked
+ Great music/sfx
+ Pixel art for level design is a great choice, considering you have less distraction in the level while enough orientation where everything is
+ Cute story, good enough to enjoy it while also not really necessary to focus on
+ Game has great level of key imputs, feeling like most of the mistakes player makes are on him
+ Developers gave some generous hitboxes

Cons:
- Like i get it, but i really hated cycles, where you have to estimate them from start and hopefully hit them in the middle of room.
- In later levels i got somewhat confused of the path i need to take. In some cases i had to search up the solution. Can be called skill issue and someone finds them as a puzzle to solve, but i would love some indicators instead.


Final result for completing all achievements:
57 hours and ~16 000 deaths. Am i Proud of it? Yes, for my first jumping genre game outside of Hollow Knigh/Silksong i think i did well and i enjoyed every moment.
